{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_df['revenue_numeric'] = completed_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_completed_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue_real = real_completed_df['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print(f'Number of real completed orders: {len(real_completed_df)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue_real}')"}
